# LifeWell

> LifeWell is one record for a whole life — health, mind, life stages, people, memories and the everyday week
> — kept by the person it belongs to. Web app and Capacitor Android app. Built and maintained by Ahsan
> Mahmood. It is NOT a health tracker: health is the largest of its seven areas and deliberately not the point
> of it.

Tagline: Your whole life, in one place.

## Structure

Seven areas, with You in the middle. You is the account, not an area, and cannot be switched off.

- Health — trackers (water, steps, weight, blood pressure, blood sugar, sleep and more), medications, food
  and meals, exercise, conditions, lab results.
- Mind — journal (mood, gratitude, dreams, free writing), guided breathing, meditation, sleep sounds, desk
  wellness breaks.
- Life stages — cycle, trying to conceive, ovulation, PCOS, menopause, breastfeeding, children (feeds, sleep,
  nappies, growth, milestones).
- People — family tree, work tree, connections, family groups, journeys, saved places and maps, messages,
  community groups, professionals directory, blood donor directory.
- Memories — photos, albums, scrapbook, tags, captions.
- Everyday — calendar and appointments, notes and folders, saved places, reminders, shopping list.
- Sharing — links you make to show someone a tracker, your medications or a family tree, or to ask for
  something back; each carries only what you choose and can be ended at any time.

Each of the first six can be switched off. Off means the menu stops listing it; nothing is deleted, and any
page still opens if you go to it directly. Sharing has no switch: it is where you end what you have shared.

## What LifeWell does NOT do

- It does not give medical advice and it is not a medical device.
- It does not keep a streak, a score, a rank, a level or a badge. There is no column for them.
- It does not sell or share your record, and there is no advertising network in the product.
- It is NOT end-to-end encrypted. The record is encrypted in transit and at rest and is readable by the
  database. Claiming otherwise would be false.
- It does not run on iOS. iOS was removed on 2026-07-16 and will be re-added when an Apple Developer account
  exists.
- It does not ship a browser extension. One is planned and not built.
- It does not connect to Google Calendar or any external calendar.
- It does not require an account for the public tools, the baby-name browser or the blood donor directory.

## Not built yet, as of 2026-09-08

- Push notifications — subscription wired, sending service not written. No push arrives.
- Global search — the server query exists; the page is a declared placeholder.
- The referral member screen — the server half is live; there is no screen showing your code.
- Deleting one area — the database transaction exists; there is no screen opening it.
- Deleting your account in-app — the button is wired; the server function is not deployed. The working route
  is https://lifewell.aoneahsan.com/delete-account
- Google Play Billing — built and tested against recorded responses; not configured and switched off.
- Over-the-air updates — planned. No package in the build.

## Your data

- Written on the device first, synced when there is a connection.
- Photos and files live in the user's own Google Drive, under a scope reaching only files LifeWell created.
  LifeWell holds a reference, not the file.
- Export everything as JSON, CSV or PDF, built in the browser rather than on a server. JSON and CSV are
  complete; the PDF deliberately omits the journal, notes, memories and messages.
- Export is available on every plan, including Free.
- Format documented field by field: https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com/reference/export-format

## Plans

Free, Pro (£3/month, £30/year) and Family (£6/month, £60/year). Split by what a use costs to run rather than
by how much of the product you get: unlimited entries on every tier, 50 people on Free, AI estimates limited
tightest and removed entirely by bringing your own key on any tier. Web payment is arranged manually; Android
sells through Google Play Billing, which is built and not switched on.

## Canonical facts

- LifeWell version: 3.0.0 — a full rebuild of the 2.x app, on a new backend, with no migration of 2.x data.
- Android application id: com.aoneahsan.lifewell · minimum Android 9 (API 28).
- Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 8, Capacitor 8 (Android only), Supabase (Postgres, row-level security,
  Google-only auth), TanStack Router and Query, Tailwind v4, React Aria Components, Zustand, react-hook-form
  with Zod, Tiptap, D3, Sentry, Google Analytics 4, Amplitude, Microsoft Clarity, OneSignal.
- NOT used: Firebase as a backend, any third-party component library, Supabase Storage, production source
  maps, plain textareas.
- Interface language: British English only. Every string goes through the translation layer, so a second
  language is one new file; none is planned.
- Live app: https://lifewell.aoneahsan.com
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aoneahsan.lifewell
- Documentation: https://lifewell-docs.aoneahsan.com
- Documentation source: https://github.com/aoneahsan/lifewell-docs (CC BY 4.0). Application source is private.
- Contact: aoneahsan@gmail.com
